name: DELTA RING 2
desc:
Experience a new breed of roblox first person shooter with all out infantry and vehicle warfare in Delta Ring 2!

💥 Fight in 8v8 large scale battles or 4v4 arena matches across 14 maps with various classic gamemodes!
🕹️ Play with up to 50 players on community made maps and gamemodes or create your own in Custom Games!
⬆️ Level up and customize your Titan with a huge selection of armor and attachments!
🏁 Complete challenges to unlock skins for 17 powerful weapons!

🖥️ Available on PC, Phones, Tablets and Console!
🌎 Join the group to be apart of the Delta Ring Community!

All assets are made originally or provided for Delta Ring 2
